name: Anti-Anti
storyline:
“I want to live in a world where no one curses my name.”

“I want to live in a world where everyone loves me.”

An audition for someone just like you—

Next Bright

The one who can save the world is you!

An audition offering an enormous cash prize to its participants—and despite never applying, you have been selected as one of the final TOP 10 contestants!

You awaken in an unfamiliar place, surrounded by unfamiliar people.

“But I can’t even sing, and I’m way too ordinary to become a celebrity...?”

What kind of hidden talent could someone as ordinary as “me” possibly possess?

As the increasingly suspicious audition continues, will “I” be able to survive until the end without being broken?

In 20XX, mysterious creatures appeared, and people began dying in droves.

Nations collapsed, and war and violence consumed everyday life. Yet the force that finally brought it all under control was neither the government nor the military.

“An idol who brings happiness and laughter to the people!”

Appearing like a comet, possessed a mysterious power through their performances—one that could instantly captivate even the most miserable and violent of people. No one disliked Light. No—no one was capable of disliking Light! For the first time, people realized that a star could exist with no haters and no malicious comments: the first in history and the first in the world.

Ten years have passed since then. Danger still remains, but the world is gradually returning to normal.

Behind the restoration of peace stood a single entertainment agency. Its name was...

'StartLight.ENT'

Recently, the company has begun spending enormous sums of money to recruit people from all walks of life for a new production.
summary: A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!
